title: Экстрим в ресторане и подарок для Саши  (Thrills at the Restaurant and a Gift for Sasha)

segments.t: Having nowhere to be alone at the apartment, Kostya and Nastya try sneaking into empty rooms at the restaurant despite the fear of getting caught. Meanwhile, Sasha throws her arms around Max to thank him for a pair of expensive earrings that Ilya secretly left for her.

'Though a bit scary.' The grammar packs 'but' and 'scary' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.

'I mean, at home you are not afraid.' Max brings out the contrast between 'sense' and 'home' in a few short words.

'Max, you are the best!' In Russian, the idea of 'Max' flows naturally into 'super' without extra filler words.

'They would not suit me.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'not', while 'for me' completes the thought.
'Get out of here.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'go' and 'from here' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
'I am going, thank you.' The meaning hinges on 'yes' working together with 'thank you' in spoken Russian. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.

Ой, у меня тоже скоро День Ангела.

That wraps up this scene as kostya and Nastya sneak around the restaurant looking for privacy, while Sasha thanks a bewildered Max for a pair of expensive earrings she found in her locker. See you next time!
